item.title: When Symmetry Learns to Read the Data
item.description: A new starG tensor algebra extracts hidden symmetry from molecular data, decomposing properties into irreducible representation channels without prior physical knowledge.

item.title: When Critics Are Right: Demanding Review Predicts Higher Impact
item.description: Papers that withstand the most demanding peer review, with strong, high-quality critiques, later earn significantly higher citations, challenging the view of review as mere gatekeeping.

item.title: Learning to Hand Off: A Provably Convergent Theory for Multi-Agent Workflows
item.description: Two AI agents coordinate through an interface-constrained handoff, communicating a single learned scalar to guarantee convergent multi-agent workflows.
